experiment_name: Greedy paired evaluation: 20-game vs 500-game DDQN checkpoints on held-out seeds 10000-10009
exact_commands: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python scripts/run_baseline_match.py --focus "ddqn:<path>/milestones/ddqn_hybrid_20_v2_milestone.pt" --opponents fixed-a fixed-b fixed-c --seed 10000-10009 --output docs/baseline_runs/eval_20game_seeds10000-10009.json

PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python scripts/run_baseline_match.py --focus "ddqn:<path>/ddqn_hybrid_20_v2.pt" --opponents fixed-a fixed-b fixed-c --seed 10000-10009 --output docs/baseline_runs/eval_500game_seeds10000-10009.json

algorithm_config.action_selection: greedy (masked argmax over Q-values, no epsilon sampling)
algorithm_config.held_out: seeds never used during training (training used seed=42-derived per-game seeds only)

result: NO IMPROVEMENT CLAIM: the 500-game checkpoint won 1/40 vs. the 20-game checkpoint's 0/40. The two Wilson 95% intervals ([0%, 8.76%] and [0.44%, 12.88%]) overlap almost completely - one additional win out of 40 paired games is statistically indistinguishable from noise at this sample size. Both checkpoints remain far below fixed-b/fixed-c. DDQN fallbacks were 0 for both checkpoints in every game, by construction (the neural adapter masks illegal actions before argmax, so it never needs the scripted-agent compatibility fallback).
notes: integrity.fallbacks (481) is the sum of both checkpoints' fixed-opponent fallback totals (214 + 267); DDQN itself contributed 0 fallbacks in both evaluations, per fallbacks_by_policy above. peak_rss_gib is null (not separately measured for these evaluation runs). This evaluation is what grounded the 2026-08-11 DECISIONS.md entry to pause further DDQN training past 500 games.
